name: GlcNAc
aliases: N-Acetylglutamine, Aceglutamide, 2-acetamido-4-carbamoyl-butanoic acid, 4-carbamoyl-2-acetamidobutanoic acid, Aceglutamid, Aceglutamide [INN], Acetylglutamine, alpha-N-Acetyl-L-glutamine
summary: Aceglutamide (brand name Neuramina), or aceglutamide aluminium (brand name Glumal), also known as acetylglutamine, is a psychostimulant, nootropic, and antiulcer agent that is marketed in Spain and Japan. It is an acetylated form of the amino acid L-glutamine, the precursor of glutamate in the body and brain. Aceglutamide functions as a prodrug to glutamine with improved potency and stability.

pharmacology.text: Aceglutamide functions as a prodrug to glutamine with improved potency and stability.

uses.text: Aceglutamide (brand name Neuramina), or aceglutamide aluminium (brand name Glumal), also known as acetylglutamine, is a psychostimulant, nootropic, and antiulcer agent that is marketed in Spain and Japan. Aceglutamide is used as a psychostimulant and nootropic, while aceglutamide aluminium is used in the treatment of ulcers.

summaryZh: 乙醯谷醯胺是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C7H12N2O4，為L-穀氨醯胺的乙醯化衍生物，可作為興奮劑、益智藥和胃及十二指腸潰瘍在西班牙和日本銷售。
summaryZhHans: 乙酰谷酰胺是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C7H12N2O4，为L-谷氨酰胺的乙酰化衍生物，可作为兴奋剂、益智药和胃及十二指肠溃疡在西班牙和日本销售。

fact.en: Aceglutamide is simply the amino acid glutamine with an acetyl group added, a small change that makes it more stable than glutamine itself.
fact.zh: Aceglutamide 其實就是胺基酸麩醯胺酸加上一個乙醯基，這個小改變讓它比麩醯胺酸本身更穩定。
fact.zhHans: Aceglutamide 其实就是胺基酸麸酰胺酸加上一个乙酰基，这个小改变让它比麸酰胺酸本身更稳定。
